verdict.rationale: Better Auth's documented design stores all auth data in your own SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL database. Community users confirm they own all the data, have no tie to a DB provider, and can add fields as plain Postgres columns. Its database adapters reportedly make switching to another provider or library relatively easy. Because the data already sits in standard SQL tables you control, leaving is feasible, but there is no documented first-party export feature or outbound migration path; the Auth0 guide covers only inbound migration. missing for 10: documented data-export tooling or format, an outbound migration/exit guide, hands-on reports of actually migrating away.
